name: Generating Documents
trigger: You build quotes, contracts, invoices, or reports by editing last month's copy.
summary: Templates consume kernel.ui tokens so generated documents match the product's branding without separate design work. Every rendering pins the template version it used, which is what makes reissuing a historical document byte-identical rather than silently restyled.

requires.reason: Templates and renderings are persisted, versioned entities.
A rendered document is stored as a file rather than regenerated on every view.

enhances.unlocks: invoices and receipts render as branded PDFs
a generated document is routed straight into a signature request
job summaries and cost reports render as documents
scheduled reports are delivered as PDFs

owns.name: TemplateVersion
owns.description: Append-only. A rendering references the version it used, so editing a template can never retroactively change an issued document.

privacy.retention_note: Documents with financial or contractual meaning are anonymised rather than deleted.

consumes.name: invoice.created
consumes.reason: render the invoice PDF as soon as it is issued

consumes.name: quote.requested
consumes.reason: render a quote document when a quoting capability is present

consumes.name: job.completed
consumes.reason: render a completion summary when ops.dispatch is present

consumes.name: report.scheduled
consumes.reason: render a scheduled report when ops.reporting is present

exposes.name: generate
exposes.signature: generate(template: TemplateRef, data: unknown, opts?: GenerateOptions): Promise<GeneratedDocument>

exposes.name: renderers
exposes.signature: renderPdf(html: string): Promise<Buffer>; renderHtml(template, data): Promise<string>

exposes.name: templateHelpers
exposes.description: Formatting helpers contributed by capabilities, so a money value renders identically in an invoice, a quote, and a report.

pdf_engine.description: 'none' disables PDF rendering and restricts output to HTML. Useful where a headless browser is not available.

slots.name: templateHelpers
slots.description: Client-specific formatting helpers available to every template.

slots.name: brandingOverride
slots.description: Per-document-type branding that differs from the application's kernel.ui tokens, such as a letterhead.

slots.name: outputFormats
slots.when: when an output format is selected
slots.description: Client-specific output formats beyond PDF and HTML.

smoke.name: template renders to PDF
smoke.asserts: a template plus data produces a non-empty PDF stored as a file

smoke.name: branding tokens are applied
smoke.asserts: a rendered document carries the manifest's brand tokens without a separate stylesheet

smoke.name: rendering is deterministic
smoke.asserts: rendering the same template version with the same data twice produces byte-identical output

contract.asserts: the rendering is stored as a file and the returned document references a retrievable file id

contract.scenario: a template is edited after an invoice was issued
contract.asserts: reissuing the historical invoice uses the pinned template version and is byte-identical to the original
